name: aspose-mcp-server
description: Process local Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, OCR, Email, and BarCode documents with Aspose MCP Server.

interface.shortDescription: Read, edit, and convert local office documents.
interface.longDescription: Uses a locally installed AsposeMcpServer executable over stdio. Download the executable for your platform and add its directory to PATH before use. Configure ASPOSE_LICENSE_PATH for licensed use; without a license, Aspose evaluation restrictions apply.
